Second, immediately enhance cybersecurity protocols to defend against escalating digital threats, and fortify physical infrastructure with robust natural disaster preparedness plans, especially in seismically active regions. Third, conduct an urgent review of asset portfolios, particularly exposure to the volatile AI sector, and consider recalibrating investments in light of technological uncertainties and global financial anxieties.
